title: Final R1 Question-Relation Authority -> Current V550/V550J Execution Court
central_proposition: Final R1 is current relation-semantic authority but is not demonstrated to be universal workload authority for every current V550/V550J computation family.

final_disposition: Final R1 directly governs current relation meaning and downstream bridge re-resolution, but current V550/V550J computation is controlled by a plural authority/execution topology: QUC synthesis, exact QSM base membership, independent joint configuration authority, shared extraction unioning, resource policy, fixed implementation inventories/defaults, association lane authority, and downstream R1 re-resolution.
